fields.mechanism: Passive structural separation via cyclone geometry without active mechanical elements, inverted to rely solely on fixed internal contours rather than driven flow acceleration
fields.intervention: Install a non-welded, drop-in passive cyclone liner with fixed geometric contours into the existing wellhead separator vessel, eliminating any active flow-driving elements and relying entirely on the static structural shape to maintain separation efficiency while providing a replaceable surface for calcite and silica deposition that can be swapped during the 4-day outage
fields.expected_effect: Calcite and silica gel deposit preferentially on the removable passive liner instead of the pressure boundary and flash-vessel internals, maintaining thermal output within acceptable limits and allowing full scale removal by replacing the liner without welding or exceeding the 180°C brine temperature constraint
fields.falsification_test: Operate the retrofitted separator at 900 mg/L calcium concentration and 180°C for 60 days; if the thermal output loss exceeds 6 percent or the passive liner cannot be removed and replaced using on-site equipment within the 4-day annual outage window, the intervention fails
